# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception: internal hosts are held to the same requirement as any other host and must not be reached over plain HTTP. The stated basis is that certificate management is now in place, so the network location of a host is not treated as a reason to skip TLS. Certificate verification stays on for all HTTPS connections.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md
